# event observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventObservation`](gmeow-eventObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventObservation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An observation made during or about an event. Inverse of [`gmeow:observationEvent`](gmeow-observationEvent.md) (observations module). Non-functional: an event may have many observations, and competing standpoint-indexed observations coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link any [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to an observation made during or about it — distinct from [`gmeow:generatedObservation`](gmeow-generatedObservation.md), which is reserved for the deliberate outputs of an [`gmeow:ObservationalActivity`](../classes/gmeow-ObservationalActivity.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for an observation that is the activity's purpose-built product (use [`gmeow:generatedObservation`](gmeow-generatedObservation.md)), and avoid collapsing competing observations — keep it non-functional so standpoint-indexed ones coexist.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:eventObservation`](gmeow-eventObservation.md) from the event, or its inverse [`gmeow:observationEvent`](gmeow-observationEvent.md) from the observation; either direction is read both ways.

### Examples

- ex:wedding [`gmeow:eventObservation`](gmeow-eventObservation.md) ex:weatherNote.
